notes.title: Pigeon Simulator
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=1xfrB2XRn34;full][/previewyoutube]

I've joined up with tinyBuild Games to expand HakJak Studios into a 5 person team and do a complete, official reboot of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jk7hQEMNjHc]Bossa Studio's original prototype from 2019[/url].  This is a fully re-imagined, re-designed, re-built-from-the-ground-up game!

[b]Our ambitious goal:[/b]  create something that feels a bit like GTA meets Goat Simulator, mixed with roguelites such as Hades--but with pigeons!  Hopefully this results in something totally weird and wonderful.

Anyways--I'm super excited and just wanted to share the news with everyone that enjoyed Guts and Glory.  Believe it or not, Pigeon Sim is going to be even crazier and weirder--and have much better controls ;)

I hope you'll check it out and help me spread the word.

notes.title: v1.0 Progress Update + Control Improvements & More
notes.content:
[i]A small update to improve controls and patch bugs until the v1.0 release. 
 Also, your own personal butler![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/10b178ec428e7c18f2e7c84cc0be15d789dfc5e6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Version 1.0 Progress Update[/h1]

I'm currently working with the awesome people at tinyBuild to do proper Quality Assurance, Optimization, and Console Porting for the huge v1.0 release.

[i]Guts and Glory version 1.0 will have a simultaneous release on PC and Consoles this Summer, and will include a TON of new content.[/i]

This means that the quality of the end product will be much better!  However, it also means that the PC version won't be ready in late Spring as I initially planned.  Instead, everything will release at the same time, but at better quality.

I apologize for the delay, but I really don’t want to half-ass the release from Steam Early Access.  The end-result will be worth the wait!

In the meantime, I'm working on a couple fun surprises to hold us all over until then....

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/f3c2ecbb8943c9a624f38d3e1da8ee2271174199.jpg[/img]

[h1]Vehicle Control Update[/h1]

[b]Several of the vehicles have been given a major physics and control overhaul![/b]

You’ll notice the biggest changes on the ATV, car, truck and motorcycle, and minor adjustments to the other vehicles.  They all handle much, much better and still maintain their power and wheel frictions so that they don't break any existing level designs.  (Flying vehicles are still undergoing some changes.)

Oh, and the Boost works like it’s supposed to now.  This should help out with breaking those Leaderboard records too 😉

[b]Please let me know what you think of the new vehicle controls in the comments below.[/b]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed bug that caused "Loading" overlay to block menu buttons if Steam Leaderboard update timed out, causing user to force quit application.

- Fixed bug that caused Chapel Hill (and a couple other levels) to crash the game on some Macs.

- Annnd fixed several boring, little things.  (Note: Settings may be reset for some players due to these changes.)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/f821eaad96e823c371b9c1c9553b155dd4cb89fb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Summon Your Personal Butler![/h1]

Also, The Butler ride-along character has now been unlocked for everyone!

[b]Simple wear the black Top Hat (won by completing all of John & Jimmy’s levels), and your personal butler will be summoned.[/b]

He lives to please, but do be careful… he’s quite fragile in his old age.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/48372f0b86f00dc5dc62e5b19f0026f6338a4dfb.gif[/img]

[h1]More to come![/h1]

I’ve also got more surprises in store between now and the big launch day, so stay tuned for update announcements!

notes.title: A Glorious New Year
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/b267929ac09653ec91d65371beb76bcd56a212d8.jpg[/img]

[b]I’m currently working on a [i]massive[/i] new update for you guys![/b]

The goal is to have this update ready for release sometime this Spring.

[h1]New stuff includes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Control and handling overhaul by the super-talented Justin Couch.  Say goodbye to twitchy controls and wonky handling.  G&G controls are getting a proper upgrade.
[*]25 brand spankin’ new Official Tracks for the new characters
[*]40+ new Level Editor items for all you wonderful Workshop Level Creators out there
[*]15 additional Steam Achievements & in-game Rewards
[*]4 major YouTuber content additions and cameos
[*]2 mini Easter Egg challenges
[*]1 magnificent Halls of Glory, including a Trophy Room to see a visual indicator of your progress
[*]Proper QA and bug squashing with the fine folks over at tinyBuild
[/list]

[b]This update will prepare things for the official version 1.0 launch and console ports.[/b]  The goal is to have this update out sometime this Spring!  It’s a ton of work, so I just wanted to let you all know what’s going on behind the curtain and what to expect in 2018.

[b]Here's a brief look at one of the YouTuber cameos, CoryxKenshin![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/bb58339fb56f7780ac38c20791d66f8a517d9a47.png[/img]

Photo on the left, 3D game model on the right.  It's crazy the gamedev software out there these days.
You can also view a cool timelapse of the character creation process over on [url=store.steampowered.com] my YouTube channel[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/12075f7d5e9088d4ccb46c069899bc7ab83bfd85.jpg[/img]

[h1]Localization[/h1]
Now that most of the new content is in place, it’s time to update all the language translations.  If you are interested in volunteering to review and edit the localization document, please email me at hakjakgames@gmail.com.  Accepted volunteers will get their names added to the Official Credits list, as well as a recommendation on LinkedIn, etc.

[i]Serious inquiries only please.  Translations will be peer-reviewed.  No new languages can be added at this time.[/i]

[h1]Current languages include:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Chinese (Simplified)
[*]Chinese (Traditional)
[*]Korean
[*]Japanese
[*]German
[*]Russian
[*]French
[*]Italian
[*]Turkish
[*]Arabic
[*]Portuguese (Brazil)
[*]Spanish
[*]Estonian
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/5da831d5e8c147fe4d8fff089d54545553527317.jpg[/img]

[h1]Got Bugs?[/h1]
If you have bugs to report, please send to hakjakbugs@gmail.com or use the in-game bug report tool.  Bug squashing and QA is a huge priority right now.  Please be sure to include computer specs and other details if you email me directly.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/5bb5aa7de8decfd35fd1915f23e163016b46854f.jpg[/img]
[i]Hmm, what would Frogger be like in Guts and Glory?[/i]

[h1]Thank you all for your support in 2017![/h1]
It’s been fun shaping this game together during Early Access and I can’t wait to see what you think of the huge 1.0 update to come this Spring! 

Sincerely,
[i]HakJak[/i]

notes.title: The Butler Patch
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/f821eaad96e823c371b9c1c9553b155dd4cb89fb.jpg[/img]

Uploaded a small patch today to fix some minor bugs and add the new Butler passenger.

[h1]Bug Fixes / Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed bug that kept the "Night Owl" achievement from being unlocked.
[*]Increased suspension strength and height for AI Cars so they can handle rougher terrain more easily.
[*]Reduced Zoe's Motorcycle suspension bounce by 40% for better control.
[*]Increased Jack & Jill's Bike and Wagon mass for better control.
[*]Increased mass of the prop trucks 4 & 5
[*]Increased FlipPad trigger height so it's more compatible with Pedro's truck.
[*]Removed Bug Report keyboard shortcuts because they interfered with custom control maps
[/list]

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE FOR LEVEL CREATORS[/b]
Avoid creating levels where the character will impact extremely stretched-out geometry at extremely high speeds, from an angle.  Apparently Unity's physics engine can't handle this and returns null values that can actually crash the game.  I'm hoping Unity will have a fix for this issue soon.  Until then, it's best to use several smaller blocks instead.  For example, build walls from multiple blocks, rather than just one super long block.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/50c9eac521470cdd9869f088462cb84d6142b510.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Butler[/h1]
Early access to The Butler is now available to the appropriate Kickstarter Backers!  Simple where to Top Hat and your personal butler will appear, eager to please.

[b]Missed the Kickstarter opportunity?  No worries!  The Butler will be available to everyone this Spring[/b] ːsteamhappyː

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/346817bcdee5ddd95f6817b638474b992fa03352.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]

notes.title: V0.8.0: Guts, HoverBoards, Leaderboards, and Pedestrian AI

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/54011b29a89035125feaa29bfbbf1b2b0d71b366.jpg[/img]

[h1]Blood, Guts and Gore Settings[/h1]

Yup, you heard right.  I finally added GUTS for all you gore lovers!  All characters, including pedestrians, now have bloody guts in their gooey middles.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/661ec0d07cdee6d53912ef4685a9d14adb2300c0.jpg[/img]

Annnnnnd Blood/Gore Settings so you can crank it up even more and paint the town red…

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/07a35fcc5c973de8e34b08697c23d8cf73ed7e4e.jpg[/img]

…OR you can turn it all OFF, if you’re not into that sort of thing and just want to enjoy all the ragdoll physics hilarity.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/4a28c656d16910427577e6696832a50b6a9eefa0.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Final Character[/h1]

Earlier this month, you guys helped me figure out who the 8th and final character should be, and here he is.  With absolutely no affiliation with any blockbuster movie whatsoever, meet the HoverBoard-riding “Junior.”

Junior is one of the few unlockable contents in the game.  Complete any 20 Official Tracks to unlock him.  He can be used on any Class B, C, or F tracks!

If it’s a Class F track, press the Boost button to get vertical lift.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/8012a7eeab39f6431229eae872a6919e5284f7d2.gif[/img]

[h1]Pedestrian AI[/h1]

One of the top requested features has been to add basic artificial intelligence to the pedestrian characters.  Now you can set them to stand, wander, or even dance like idiots.  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/cfae28ef21451f537bfbdecc4c9eac05516e15e3.gif[/img]

They’re somewhat aware of their surroundings and will attempt to flee from danger and try to avoid falling off of ledges.
It’s very basic AI, so they’re still pretty stupid, but entertaining.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/518edf5f567e24d8c346b076f12384109b47fa48.jpg[/img]

[h1]Community Track Leaderboards[/h1]

Community Tracks now have their own leaderboards too.
 
Old scores are not auto-uploaded like the Official Tracks were, so these are clean slates, ready for you to claim your spot at the top as the most glorious player in the world!

[h1]Rotating Blocks[/h1]

I added a few new Blocks under the “Physics Blocks” category.  These rotate around their centers and can be rotated and scaled however you wish.  Should provide some really interesting level design options for all you creative types out there.

[h1]Barrel Launcher[/h1]

If you’ve ever discovered the Easter Egg level in the game, then you’ve ran into these Donkey Kong-esque bouncing barrels!  These are now available in the Level Editor for your sandbox physics entertainment.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

No update would be complete without some bug fixes.  Here’s a brief recap:

- Fixed Leaderboards sometimes not appearing after completing a level.
- Fixed "Next Track" button sometimes redirecting player to Main Menu when it shouldn't.
- Fixed pedestrian hand rigs
- Fixed Pedro being unaffected by Acid Fog and some other Hazards + other minor fixes to Pedro and his truck.
- Fixed 'Pumpkin Destructible' having no gravity while in Level Editor
- Fixed Settings-->General UI navigation issue with controller/keyboard input
- Improved Leaderboard update reliability
- Blood decal rendering optimizations

Special thanks to the handful of dedicated players that have consistently sent me quality bug reports!  Very helpful, especially in these later stages of development.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/f25e8cbda61946973ac8635835e9e2ea2ac74b34.jpg[/img]

[h1]Halloween Items[/h1]

If you missed the update earlier this month, I also added several new Halloween and Christmas props to the Level Editor.

I hope you all enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Community Vote #4: Who Will Ride the HoverBoard?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/3e325be2e5f11e52bc9f27f23a8717b423631ec7.jpg[/img]

[i]Join me for the final Community Vote![/i]

[h1]There’s one vehicle type that I’ve received more requests for than any other: a HoverBoard![/h1]

At first I didn’t think I could fit this into the game, but now I think I’ve found a way that makes sense.  Here's a brief outline:

[b]- Use on any track:[/b]  In Class F (flying) tracks, it would have vertical lift at the press of a button, allowing it to “fly.”

[b]- Simple Controls:[/b]  Drive and steer similar to a bicycle; no funky controls like Larry

[b]- Unlock this vehicle[/b] by completing any 2-4 Track Groups??  Or just put it in right away like the rest?

Think of this as a “first gen” hover board.  It won’t be perfect, but it will be funny!  The character will have floppy ragdoll physics, flailing his/her arms around, trying to maintain balance while you cruise through the course.  It should bring a fun new dynamic to the game, and offers one more vehicle option for all tracks.

But the big question is…

[b]WHO WILL RIDE THE HOVERBOARD?[/b]

This is where you come in.

[list]
[*]Should I scan my face and put myself in the game?
[*]Should I add a big YouTuber personality, like JackSepticEye?

[*]Or how about a Japanese business man?

[*]Or………..????
[*]Aaaaaaah!  Help me decide!
[/list]

[b]Vote in the comments below![/b]

notes.title: v0.7.1: Pedro's Grande Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/d76b66a5a4fcf62cefbfa0234fbe02b808492803.jpg[/img]

[b]New Character: Pedro[/b]
[b][i]HUGE[/i] Optimization Overhaul![/b]
[b]100+ New Level Editor Items[/b]
Halloween & Christmas Props
New AI Vehicles
Orbit Cam, Pause Cam, and In-Game Screenshots
Shift-Click: Multi-Object Editing
Lighting/Time of Day System
New Materials + Physics, including Mud, Snow, and Ice!
25 New Music Tracks
[i]And yes, even more![/i]

https://youtu.be/dmGXsNlanl4
ಠ‿ಠ  Do it for the glory!

This update brings Guts and Glory a big step closer to being finished.  [b]Major[/b] performance improvements, a new character, and [i]tons[/i] of new level creation content—just in time for making holiday levels too!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/15744139f9209069eb9ee508f9cd9dbefe3b302b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pedro Sanchez[/h1]

Last month, you guys voted on your favorite version of Pedro and here he is!  Pedro Sanchez is one of the finest getaway drivers for the Mexican Cartel.  His reckless attitude and manly mustache makes him the envy of men and the desire of women.

Pedro’s truck “El Toro” has a faster acceleration and higher suspension than the Yang’s car.  It can also sustain more damage.  However, it has a lower top speed and is much harder to drift (use the emergency brake at high speed).

[b]The Voice of Pedro[/b]

In a future update, Pedro will be voiced by the legendary [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/UberHaxorNova]UberHaxorNova![/url] 
 Coincidentally, he also did the voice for “Pogo Stick Guy” in Happy Wheels. 
 [i]Wuuuuuuut?![/i]

For now, however, Pedro is mute.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/f3c2ecbb8943c9a624f38d3e1da8ee2271174199.jpg[/img]

[h1]Orbit Cam[/h1]

I was finally able to add this long-requested feature and make it work with the “smart cam.”  It may need a little more polish, so as usual your feedback is welcome.

[u]DEFAULT CONTROLS:[/u]

Controller: Use right stick. Hold between 0-50% to maintain view angle.

Mouse: click-and-drag any button

Keyboard: uses legacy controls

This finally allows for more vertical level designs to work, and makes it easier to see where those poor passengers end up.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/b80f19a7484931485a599bec74f580df049965a6.gif[/img]

[h1]Glory Cam[/h1]

Now you can pause the game and view the destruction from any angle!  Easily rotate around objects in a Matrix-like fashion, or fly around the scene and view anything you wish.

[u]DEFAULT CONTROLS:[/u]

[b]Keyboard & Mouse:[/b]
Click-and-Drag Mouse to rotate/steer
W, A, S, D, Q, E keys to move camera

[b]Controller:[/b]
Right-Stick: rotate/steer
D-Pad: pan camera
Triggers: move in/out
(Left-Stick is still used to navigate menus)

When you’re near objects, the camera will rotate around them.  When you move the camera away, it can be steered as if you’re flying the camera around the scene.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/c5a77f861bb8a46abbc831778953315564c9c76f.png[/img]

[h1]In-Game Screenshots[/h1]

Want to share a glorious moment or capture a great video thumbnail?  Now it’s easier than ever!

Just click the Camera Icon on the pause screen and it will save a screenshot to your documents folder [i]with all UI removed.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/ec2e9f3959c2fa635a98bfe7d16157a9c51b2274.jpg[/img]

[h1]LEVEL EDITOR[/h1]

Tons of new stuff for all you Level Creators out there!

[b]Max Complexity Limit increased by 25%![/b]

Camera movement speed increased too.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/840f3c67373bdd7b8c25988508984f4c147b7529.gif[/img]

[h1]Multi-Object Editing[/h1]

Now you can edit lots of objects at the same time!

[b]Shift-Click to select multiple items[/b]

[u]Supports:[/u] select, move, rotate, delete, cloning, color, material, and option changes.

(Scaling not supported.)

This feature was tricky to implement, but totally worth it.  It makes level building so much faster and enjoyable.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/cdccc7d1a044a46bea324bbe092d24d4468cdd57.png[/img]

[h1]LightBox[/h1]

[i]Special Items-->LightBox[/i]

Just drag-and-drop this item anywhere in your scene and select a preset to adjust the overall lighting and atmosphere.

[b]25 different presets![/b]

If you make any dark levels, it’s highly recommended that you add some lights too.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/8eaee96a8c3eae0fd6b43c7853a2d918f5f3bf2f.gif[/img]

[h1]Point Lights & Spot Lights[/h1]

Good lighting can make a mediocre scene look great! Just drag-and-drop them into your scene and select a color option.  They’ll activate automatically if the level is dark enough.

Point Lights cast light in a radius around them.  They’re perfect for general lighting needs.

Spot Lights project a circle of light in one direction.  Rotate them to get the effect you need.

Also, the Level Editor cameras now render all lighting effects as well, so you can preview the final look in realtime (light glow, “god rays”, fog, etc.)

[i]Tip: avoid lighting overlaps for best performance[/i]

[h1]MusicBox[/h1]

I added a visible trigger radius to the MusicBox when in the Level Editor.  Add MusicBoxes along the track to change the music/mood during a track.

[b]Auto-Play:[/b] If only 1 MusicBox is in the level, it will now auto-play no matter where it’s placed (no triggering needed).

Added 20 new Music Tracks, including holiday themed songs.

Added 5 new Ambience Sound Tracks, like city sounds and desert winds.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/dafffea176d0830463f5abf36d24444e3a09a290.png[/img]

[h1]New Materials + Physics[/h1]

[b]Added 44 new Terrain Textures,[/b] including Snow, Ice, and desert Sand sets.  These affect wheel friction physics too.

[u]Added 6 new Material options for Blocks, each with their own physics and wheel FX:[/u]
-	Earth
-	Mud
-	Sandstone
-	Snow
-	Ice
-	Neon Glow (shows during play mode)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/f37b8d1c957ca409ee4df03254c6b942607d10a4.gif[/img]

[h1]100+ New Items![/h1]

These are just some of the new items you can find in the Level Editor.

[b]Death Fog[/b]

Causes instant death if any part of the driver touches it.
Scales to easily cover large areas.  For example, “Don’t touch the lava” type levels.

[b]Acid Fog[/b]

Instantly eats away any portion of any character that touches it.
Useful when you want to create smaller, custom hazards. 

[b]Funny Fog[/b]

AKA “Bobble Head Maker”
Each time a character passes through this volume it makes their head grow larger. xD

[url=https://twitter.com/HakJakGames/status/907234045033046016]You can see short previews on my Twitter.[/url]

[h1]Props (general)[/h1]

A big assortment of new props under several sub-categories.  Includes rubber tires, bowling pins, boxes, garbage, new fence types, wind turbines, new buildings, and more.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/696c724c018465915e1713379afd00353ba21a42.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/e0140b9d3d8430443cb7ebff02170e0e63a37027.png[/img]

[b]Holiday Props[/b]

A bunch of holiday-themed props, including Halloween and Christmas stuff.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/dd0b38e3ef5e9cca5dbce21ebcf73cc6d63dd5e8.png[/img]

[b]Electronic Road Sign[/b]
An electronic road sign with a ton of different message options.  (Thanks everyone who tweeted me ideas for this!)

[b]Prop Vehicles[/b]

Several new prop vehicles to decorate the track / use for obstacles.  Ranging from small to large.

[b]Nature[/b]

New Material options for Rocks (desert, snow, etc.), assorted Grasses, and even Cactuses.  (Yes, the cactus spikes can hurt you!)

[b]Prop Characters[/b]

Cardboard cut-out type characters that you can use to quickly make background audiences and on-lookers… or whatever you want.

[b]Audiences[/b]

[i]Buildings-->Special-->Grandstand[/i]

Easily add a cheering crowd to your levels for extra glory.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/a398fd16218e88b9206847ffa140b18e109253d2.png[/img]

[h1]New AI Vehicles[/h1]

The standard AI Cars have been upgraded!  They now have an interior, transparent windows, lights, and even a driver!

I also added 2 new options: Police Cars and Border Patrol Cars (complete with sirens!)

[h1]Added 4 new AI Vehicle Types:[/h1]

[b]School Bus[/b]
Cuz why not?

[b]Monster Trucks[/b]
Can also be equipped with Hazards, such as Lasers, Cannons, or Mad Max style spikes and saws!

[b]Big Rig[/b]
Create your own “Clustertruck” inspired levels or just add some very dangerous traffic.  Careful waypoint placement and speed settings are key for getting smooth driving out of these due to their large size and towed trailers.

[b]Santa Claus[/b]
The version that’s been drinking too much egg nog….

[h1]TECHNICAL STUFF:[/h1]

Upgraded entire project to Unity Engine 5.6.3

[b]MAJOR optimization overhaul![/b]
- More content but smaller application size
- Faster load times and higher FPS
- Updated shaders and driver plug-ins
- Heavily optimized all texture files: smaller build, faster performance, and more compatible with older setups

[list]
[*]FPS Counter now shows Memory stats too
[*]New Outline shader in Level Editor
[*]Engine audio no longer cuts out after driver dismount/death

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/15744139f9209069eb9ee508f9cd9dbefe3b302b.jpg[/img]

Last month, you guys voted on your favorite version of Pedro and here he is!  Pedro Sanchez is one of the finest getaway drivers for the Mexican Cartel.  His reckless attitude and manly mustache makes him the envy of men and the desire of women.

Pedro’s truck “El Toro” has a faster acceleration and higher suspension than the Yang’s car.  It can also sustain more damage.  However, it has a lower top speed and is much harder to drift (use the emergency brake at high speed).

[b]The Voice of Pedro[/b]

In a future update, Pedro will be voiced by the legendary [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/UberHaxorNova]UberHaxorNova![/url] 
 Coincidentally, he also did the voice for “Pogo Stick Guy” in Happy Wheels. 
 [i]Wuuuuuuut?![/i]

For now, however, Pedro is mute.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/f3c2ecbb8943c9a624f38d3e1da8ee2271174199.jpg[/img]

[u]DEFAULT CONTROLS:[/u]

Controller: Use right stick. Hold between 0-50% to maintain view angle.

Mouse: click-and-drag any button

Keyboard: uses legacy controls

This finally allows for more vertical level designs to work, and makes it easier to see where those poor passengers end up.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/b80f19a7484931485a599bec74f580df049965a6.gif[/img]

[b]Keyboard & Mouse:[/b]
Click-and-Drag Mouse to rotate/steer
W, A, S, D, Q, E keys to move camera

Right-Stick: rotate/steer
D-Pad: pan camera
Triggers: move in/out

Instantly eats away any portion of any character that touches it.
Useful when you want to create smaller, custom hazards.

Each time a character passes through this volume it makes their head grow larger. xD

[h1]What content should be included in the next major update?[/h1]
We’re doing things a little differently this time around, see below….

[b]“Vote” now by commenting on this Steam Announcement page.[/b]
1.)	Select your favorite Character option.
2.)	Select the top several Content options you would like to see in the game; help me prioritize feature development!

[i]Only 2 Community Vote events remain![/i]

For these updates, I will re-prioritize the to-do list based on your feedback.  Then I’ll work through these items starting at the top, adding as many new features as I can before it’s time to release a new update. When the next update releases, I’ll update the list and repeat!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/7bed2d32b32668da5daf532481914c7c2657d242.png[/img]

[h1]1.)  Character Options:[/h1]

[b]The Life of Pedro[/b]

[i]Class C Vehicle: a small pick-up truck[/i]

The next contestant for the Guts and Glory games will be the legendary Pedro!

Pedro has lead quite an interesting life, and spent many miles behind the wheel of his favorite pick-up truck.  For this week’s event, you get to decide which version of Pedro will be featured in the game.  [b]Should it be Pedro Past, Present, or Future?[/b]  Let me know in the comments below!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/86ea25bc2e97885f078ce7230d619b3da8713a11.png[/img]

[h1]Pedro Past[/h1]

In his past life, Pedro was a driver for the Mexican cartel.  He enjoyed fine cigars, fine woman, and an exciting life.

As you can see in the super technical drawing below, this version of Pedro looks confident and he’s smoking a cigar.  There are 2-3 cartel thugs in the back, bags of blow, and suitcases full of money.  Dollar bills trail behind the vehicle, blowing in the wind.  A crash could result in money and snow flying everywhere.

[i]Mustache Level: pequeña[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/0babe8c3d742a79788a216a9fb550a492a70caef.png[/img]

[h1]Pedro Present[/h1]

After a recent job went sideways, Pedro finds himself on the run!  He gathers up his famila, a few belongings, and makes a run for the border… with the cartel hot on his heels.

This version of Pedro is wild-eyed!  His caliente wife sits in the passenger seat.  His mother and daughter sit in the bed of the truck, along with several belongings, such as suitcases, boxes, and a chicken in a cage.

[i]Mustache Level: medio[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/948091729f3336fbe5f2ccb2e833773b287ca927.png[/img]

[h1]Pedro Future[/h1]

Pedro is a made man.  He’s established himself in a new country, and now runs an incredibly successful “lawn management company” with some very loyal and well-paid employees.

It’s totally legit.  Seriously.

No, those aren’t guns in the back… those are just weed-eaters.  That green stuff in the bags is just lawn clippings, not cash.  It’s not what you think it is....

Okay, if you keep asking so many questions we might have to show you the wood-chipper….

[i]Mustache Level: grande[/i]

-------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]2.)  Content Options:[/h1]

Below is a list of feature options in no particular order.

[b]Please list the top features you would like to see added to the game, in order of priority.[/b]

[u]THE LIST:[/u]
[list]
[*] Guts
[*] Blood/Gore Settings: increase, decrease, or turn off
[*] Desert Theme: textures and props
[*] Snow and Ice: textures and props
[*] Time of Day + Lights with color options
[*] Special FX: fog, dust, smoke, embers, etc.
[*] More Materials: lava, death fog, transparency, etc.
[*] AI Vehicle Updates: more types (Mad Max anyone?), updated models, ragdoll drivers
[*] Level Editor optimization: double level size limit
[*] Camera Switch: toggle between characters
[*] Orbit Camera: move mouse to look around; snaps back after you stop
[*] Community Track Leaderboards
[*] Pedestrian AI: simple wander and flee behaviors
[*] Driver Ragdoll Movement: apply forces to flop around in a given direction
[*] Steam Avatar Box: add your "signature" to levels by dropping in a resizable cube with your Steam Avatar icon on it.
[*] Tutorial Videos / Guide
[*] Zero Gravity Zones
[*] More Hazards: _________?
[*] More Special Items:  _________?
[*] More Props: _________?
[*] Other...?
[/list]

[h1]Not Listed[/h1]

[b]Trading Cards + More Achievements[/b]
I plan on adding these on Full Release launch :)

[b]More Official Tracks[/b]
Many more Official Tracks will be added for Full Release!

[b]Level Editor Logic / Triggers[/b]
This is more complicated than I anticipated, but I plan on giving it a try when the game is close to finished, so I don't slow everything else down in the meantime.  I want there to be [i]some[/i] sort of behavior options available.

[b]Mutliplayer[/b]
I know this is a highly requested feature.  However, I must wait until the game is nearly finished before I can give this a try.  My first priority is to get the single player experience finished on time.  Then I can take a swing at this.

[b]Fire, Water, and Replays[/b]
These are very technical and time-consuming features to implement properly.  Rather than make a half-ass implementation, I'm crossing them off the list... perhaps if I make an expansion or 2.0 some day.  But right now it's simply too much work to do alone and will slow everything way down.

I'm ready to crank out some new content quickly!

[h1]Time to hit the boost button on development![/h1]

Many more Official Tracks will be added for Full Release!

[b]Level Editor Logic / Triggers[/b]
This is more complicated than I anticipated, but I plan on giving it a try when the game is close to finished, so I don't slow everything else down in the meantime.  I want there to be [i]some[/i] sort of behavior options available.

[b]Mutliplayer[/b]
I know this is a highly requested feature.  However, I must wait until the game is nearly finished before I can give this a try.  My first priority is to get the single player experience finished on time.  Then I can take a swing at this.

[b]Fire, Water, and Replays[/b]
These are very technical and time-consuming features to implement properly.  Rather than make a half-ass implementation, I'm crossing them off the list... perhaps if I make an expansion or 2.0 some day.  But right now it's simply too much work to do alone and will slow everything way down.

I'm ready to crank out some new content quickly!

Navigate to Props-->Destructible Items to start using them now and add some more chaos to those Community Tracks.  There's a wide variety to choose from, including Glass, Chip Boards, Fences, Dishes, and the classic Wooden Barrel.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/4a5f6dd58314dc9033466a1ebb888c5d1fa5502b.png[/img]

notes.title: v0.5.2: Big Summer Update #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/cbe5acbe1a96c4367074d057e5675320e4ed4c16.png[/img]

Earlier this month, you guys voted for the new content you wanted to see in Guts and Glory and now it’s here!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/f8940ce11ca4d36e39f4a02f576a48ae5df13be7.gif[/img]

[b]This Summer is all about community content.[/b]  More characters, more hazards, and more awesome Workshop content so you guys can keep making bigger and better Community Tracks.  [i]Let's build some glorious new community challenges![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/0106ef782bdeab707ac46d80d2c9660338edce09.jpg[/img]

[h1]Jack & Jill[/h1]

[i]Jack and Jill went up a hill… and then they rolled down in pieces.[/i]

This week Guts and Glory gets a brand new set of Class A characters!  Trying to make it to the finish line with sister in tow can be a real challenge… but if you just get tired of her you can disconnect the rope at any time!  (Just press the new Eject button once.)

Jack and Jill are just two fun-loving kids. Brother and sister, actually. Unlike most siblings, they get along well together (most of the time) and love to go on adventures any chance they get. As long as they’re back home in time for dinner, their parents pretty much let them do anything they want.

While getting slushies at their local convenience store, they saw a poster for The Guts and Glory Games and signed up the same day (there’s no age limits, after all). Now they could go on “the ultimate adventure” and win a ton of money! Great idea, right?

Jack rides a child’s version of the popular Golden Goose brand of bicycles, and generally tows his sister around in a small “Lil Waggy” brand wagon. They’ve gotten pretty good at doing jumps and stuff, so they're totally ready for this.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/7be13136bf3b85cb9e0eca8bec90d08d55b1ee18.jpg[/img]

[h1]EJECT![/h1]

At last!  You can now manually eject the driver at any time.  [b]Just press the “Z” key to launch your character from their seat (“B” button on Xbox controllers | “Circle” button on Playstation controllers).[/b]  They’ll go flying in whatever direction the top of your vehicle is pointing, so lots of creative level design potential here!

[b]If you’re using Jack and Jill, the first press will disconnect the wagon.  Second press will eject Jack.[/b]

I also removed the need for the main character to actually be alive to finish a level.  This means you can even complete a track by ejecting yourself across the finish line!

[i]What kinds of tracks will you make with this new feature?[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/d8afba9894f5bdb0ac20bd17a407ccaffce3d3f7.jpg[/img]

[h1]AI Vehicles[/h1]

You asked for it, you got it.  AI Vehicles are in the game and they’re even destructible!

Like almost everything else in Guts and Glory, these vehicles are physics-based.  They’ll be affected by ground traction, wheel slip, collisions, broken parts, etc.  They’re currently in an early stage, so the 3D models  and textures are basic.  After they get battle-tested in this update, I’ll convert to final graphics and add more vehicle types, based on future community votes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/b8dd5a0015c7dc21b716fe5a2646633e4eadda5e.png[/img]

[b]Using AI Vehicles is super simple:[/b]
1.  Drag-and-drop Vehicle Waypoints.  They’ll be auto-connected as you add/delete them.
2.  Tweak Waypoint Options.  You can set Approach Speed, Stop, or even Chase Player per Waypoint!
3.  Drag-and-drop AI Vehicles wherever you want them to start.  Anywhere!  They will automatically find their closest Waypoint and start following the path.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/ff48069ec0cc49b65fde5c235ad46966c0ca6a7b.png[/img]

Each AI Vehicle also has 10 different paint options, to add variety.  These simple skins will be replaced by final versions later, and more vehicle types will be added too!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/c05189aa5f8345a7c7a917e792bfa0a28b7c34bf.png[/img]

[h1]Workshop Content[/h1]

Tracks can now be bigger!  Level Complexity Limit increased by 14% (from 6000 to 7000).

I also just finished porting a bunch of content from Larry’s levels over to the Level Editor.  You can now make your tracks even more epic with these fine additions:
[list]
[*]14 new city buildings, ranging from small storefronts to huge skyscrapers
[*]Laser Turrets, with 4 options
[*]Reflector Turrets, with 4 options
[*]SmartBomb Turrets
[*]AI Vehicles and Waypoints
[*]Minor prop additions
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/1ee7f90e30479e0d4567e636f026025eac71e291.jpg[/img]

[h1]Kickstarter Reward DLCs[/h1]

It’s been a long wait, but the first stage of Kickstarter Reward DLCs are finally ready.  These include:
[list]
[*]The Wacky Hat Pack: a set of 5 ridiculous hats
[*]The Golden Prestige Bicycle: behold its shiny glory (applies to Jack’s bike too)
[*]The Golden Crowns (standard and XL): a symbol of greatness for those who sacrificed their hard-earned coin to help make Guts and Glory even bigger and better!
[/list]

[b]Keep an eye on your Humble Downloads page for Steam Keys this month.[/b]  If you can’t find your page, you can re-request access here [link] or search your inbox for the original Humble email.  Message me on Kickstarter if you have any difficulties.  All keys should be on your download page no later than June 30th.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/ce1007cbd1dee64cc4757919729d8c41e32daec0.jpg[/img]

[h1]General Improvements[/h1]

As usual, I’ve made several other improvements and bug fixes during development.  These include:

- Did optimization pass on all Official Tracks.  Approximately 5-15% performance increases.  (Most noticeable on lower-end CPUs.)
- Added display numbers above each Checkpoint in Level Editor, for easier editing.
- Fixed bug that prevented character from dismounting if they lost both upper/lower limbs on bicycles.
- Reduced bicycle Boost burn rate by 33% (ie-boost lasts longer).  Pedal faster, longer!
- Fixed hat selection menu scaling/aspect ratio issues.
- Added an "X" button to Settings window, for navigation clarity.  Has same functionality as the "Save and Quit" button.
- Changed "Light" to "Eject" in Settings-->Control Mapping menu.  Updated Localization accordingly for controller mapping.
- Removed need for Player Character to be alive to reach Finish Line.  (Can even finish using manual eject.)
- Changed version logging system for more accurate future bug report management
- Fixed bug that caused player to basically be invincible if he died after crossing finish point and then clicked "next track" button.
- [Fixed?] no sound bug when switching tracks, experienced by some players.
Community Tracks Menu
- Added controller/keyboard auto-scrolling to Community Track and Level Editor menus.
- Fixed menu scaling/screen ratios on pause screen pop-up version.
- [Fixed?] bug that causes Community Tracks pop-up menu to freeze/become non-interactive for some players.
- Added a manual close button, in case auto-close fails

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/448b9047afb4d3248f1273a56d53d49b77a7c8f5.jpg[/img]

[h1]What will you create?[/h1]

I can’t wait to see what crazy things you guys come up with using all this new Workshop content!  Send me a link/level name of your best tracks built primarily for Jack and Jill [i]or[/i] the new Eject feature, and I’ll feature them on a future post ːsteamhappyː

I'll be posting a new track or two myself sometime soon too!

notes.title: Community Vote #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/0c66302f9866b2bca5840f450f49183206008b5a.png[/img]

----- VOTING IS OVER.  THANKS FOR PARTICIPATING! -----

[h1]What content should be included in next major update?[/h1]

[b]“Vote” by commenting on this Steam Announcement page.[/b]
Select both a Character and Content Option from below!

Feel free to comment further on your decision or leave other feedback.  The final options chosen will be determined by a mix of the total votes [i]and[/i] the content of any discussions created in the comments.

Recommending ideas outside the scope of these options should be done in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/537340/discussions/0/133257324795106563/]Suggessions Forum[/url], and may be used in future Community Vote events.  The un-used options from each vote [i]might[/i] be presented again in a future Community Vote, but no promises.

[b]Final decision will be made on June 1st.[/b]

-------------------------------------------------------------

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/b37937b36ec41934a8d28f783da7efe6a5e17916.png[/img]

[h1]Character Option A:[/h1]

[b]Mom & Daughters[/b]

[i]Class A Vehicle[/i]

Guts and Glory is lacking a strong, female lead.  This option would fix that.  Sure, she might be irresponsible, but damn is she determined to win at all costs!

This mother of two was once on her way to being an Olympic Gold Medalist.  She had everything going for her until the day she fell in love with a pole vaulter.  One night of fun turned into a big surprise when she found out she was pregnant—with twins!  The second her lover found out, he jumped the fence and disappeared… just like her Olympic dreams.

With the announcement of The Guts and Glory Games, this tiger mom saw her opportunity to rise to greatness once again!  But it’s up to you to decide if she will be entered in the competition….

This character rides a Dutch Cargo Bike.  Popular in the Netherlands, these interesting vehicles have a box-like compartment on the front, typically used by children / cargo (and sometimes even adults).

Obviously, these characters also need good names.  Suggestions?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/6bb47cc3d4ea3b6be200cf9cdd2a06f1f9b191f9.png[/img]

[h1]Character Option B:[/h1]

[b]Jack & Jill[/b]

[i]Class A Vehicle[/i]

Jack and Jill are just two fun-loving kids!  Brother and sister, actually.  Unlike most siblings, they get along well together (most of the time) and love to go on adventures any chance they get.  As long as they’re back home in time for dinner, their parents pretty much let them do anything they want.

While getting slushies at their local convenience store, they saw a poster for The Guts and Glory Games and signed up the same day (there’s no age limits, after all).  Now they could go on “the ultimate adventure” and win a ton of money!  Great idea, right?

Jack rides a child’s version of the popular Golden Goose brand of bicycles, and generally tows his sister around in a small wagon, connected by rope.  They’ve gotten pretty good at doing jumps and stuff, so they're totally ready for this.

-------------------------------------------------------------

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/285f888de09be0e902f192aeb66d6e3ca615ce2c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Content Option A:[/h1]

[b]Fire / Lava[/b]

Things like flamethrower turrets, “ground is lava” (but really), and oil.

There are limits to what I can do here, given how the game is constructed.  For example, I wouldn’t make trees burn down, or cause a whole forest fire, or other advanced propagation systems.  However, I could do simpler systems, like one character catching another on fire, oil slicks catching fire, etc. 

If a character is covered in too much fire, they will lose health over time until they die.

There is no water in the game yet, but I might be able to add fire extinguishers if there is time left.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/722fe87cfc2268d228b1bdc765735fc85dc58019.png[/img]

[h1]Content Option B:[/h1]

[b]AI Traffic[/b]

Simple AI vehicles that travel on a set path / from waypoint-to-waypoint.

This could be used to create traffic patterns the player must drive with/against/across.  For example, you could make a ClusterTruck or Frogger type level, or even a make-shift “race.”  These could also be used to help bring more life to a level. 

I already have part of this built in very early prototyping stages, but would need to do a lot more work in order to make it ready for use in the Level Editor.


[i]CAST YOUR VOTE BY COMMENTING BELOW![/i]

-------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Why the change?[/h1]

Today marks a special occasion: it’s the first ever “Community Vote” for Guts and Glory.  This means you get to help decide what content will be developed next!  It’s kind of like a “Choose Your Own Adventure” for game development.

[b]Over the next few updates, all Official Track development is being put on hold so I can focus on cranking out more frequently requested content, finishing Kickstarter Rewards, and nurturing the G&G Community.[/b]  This means you’ll get more Characters, more Hazards, and more Community Content faster than ever before!

[h1]If you’re a YouTuber, you’ll also want to take note of this.[/h1]  The focus for the next couple months will be on Community Tracks, and new Community Content, including new Characters, Hazards, and more!

With my old development plan, it was taking far too long to bring you new content—especially highly requested features, like new Characters or finishing Kickstarter rewards.  With this new plan, I can bring players more of what they want sooner, and then re-work and finish the Official Tracks as the game gets closer to completion.  [b]New Official Tracks, plus the Halls of Glory, will get their “big reveal” during the Full Release of the game.[/b]


[i]This first Community Vote is an experiment.  If lots of people participate, then I’ll continue with the process.  Otherwise, I’ll revert to the traditional development system for the remainder of the project and update the Early Access description page accordingly.[/i] 

Spread the word!

Guts and Glory also has a Discord server, if you're into that sort of thing.  Here's a special little invite, just for you ːsteamhappyː

Select both a Character and Content Option from below!

Feel free to comment further on your decision or leave other feedback.  The final options chosen will be determined by a mix of the total votes [i]and[/i] the content of any discussions created in the comments.

Recommending ideas outside the scope of these options should be done in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/537340/discussions/0/133257324795106563/]Suggessions Forum[/url], and may be used in future Community Vote events.  The un-used options from each vote [i]might[/i] be presented again in a future Community Vote, but no promises.

[b]Final decision will be made on June 1st.[/b]

-------------------------------------------------------------

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/b37937b36ec41934a8d28f783da7efe6a5e17916.png[/img]

[h1]Character Option A:[/h1]

[b]Mom & Daughters[/b]

[i]Class A Vehicle[/i]

Guts and Glory is lacking a strong, female lead.  This option would fix that.  Sure, she might be irresponsible, but damn is she determined to win at all costs!

This mother of two was once on her way to being an Olympic Gold Medalist.  She had everything going for her until the day she fell in love with a pole vaulter.  One night of fun turned into a big surprise when she found out she was pregnant—with twins!  The second her lover found out, he jumped the fence and disappeared… just like her Olympic dreams.

With the announcement of The Guts and Glory Games, this tiger mom saw her opportunity to rise to greatness once again!  But it’s up to you to decide if she will be entered in the competition….

This character rides a Dutch Cargo Bike.  Popular in the Netherlands, these interesting vehicles have a box-like compartment on the front, typically used by children / cargo (and sometimes even adults).

Obviously, these characters also need good names.  Suggestions?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/6bb47cc3d4ea3b6be200cf9cdd2a06f1f9b191f9.png[/img]

[h1]Character Option B:[/h1]

[b]Jack & Jill[/b]

[i]Class A Vehicle[/i]

Jack and Jill are just two fun-loving kids!  Brother and sister, actually.  Unlike most siblings, they get along well together (most of the time) and love to go on adventures any chance they get.  As long as they’re back home in time for dinner, their parents pretty much let them do anything they want.

While getting slushies at their local convenience store, they saw a poster for The Guts and Glory Games and signed up the same day (there’s no age limits, after all).  Now they could go on “the ultimate adventure” and win a ton of money!  Great idea, right?

Jack rides a child’s version of the popular Golden Goose brand of bicycles, and generally tows his sister around in a small wagon, connected by rope.  They’ve gotten pretty good at doing jumps and stuff, so they're totally ready for this.

-------------------------------------------------------------

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/285f888de09be0e902f192aeb66d6e3ca615ce2c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Content Option A:[/h1]

[b]Fire / Lava[/b]

Things like flamethrower turrets, “ground is lava” (but really), and oil.

There are limits to what I can do here, given how the game is constructed.  For example, I wouldn’t make trees burn down, or cause a whole forest fire, or other advanced propagation systems.  However, I could do simpler systems, like one character catching another on fire, oil slicks catching fire, etc. 

If a character is covered in too much fire, they will lose health over time until they die.

There is no water in the game yet, but I might be able to add fire extinguishers if there is time left.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/722fe87cfc2268d228b1bdc765735fc85dc58019.png[/img]

[h1]Content Option B:[/h1]

[b]AI Traffic[/b]

Simple AI vehicles that travel on a set path / from waypoint-to-waypoint.

This could be used to create traffic patterns the player must drive with/against/across.  For example, you could make a ClusterTruck or Frogger type level, or even a make-shift “race.”  These could also be used to help bring more life to a level. 

I already have part of this built in very early prototyping stages, but would need to do a lot more work in order to make it ready for use in the Level Editor.


[i]CAST YOUR VOTE BY COMMENTING BELOW![/i]

-------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Why the change?[/h1]

Today marks a special occasion: it’s the first ever “Community Vote” for Guts and Glory.  This means you get to help decide what content will be developed next!  It’s kind of like a “Choose Your Own Adventure” for game development.

[b]Over the next few updates, all Official Track development is being put on hold so I can focus on cranking out more frequently requested content, finishing Kickstarter Rewards, and nurturing the G&G Community.[/b]  This means you’ll get more Characters, more Hazards, and more Community Content faster than ever before!

[h1]If you’re a YouTuber, you’ll also want to take note of this.[/h1]  The focus for the next couple months will be on Community Tracks, and new Community Content, including new Characters, Hazards, and more!

With my old development plan, it was taking far too long to bring you new content—especially highly requested features, like new Characters or finishing Kickstarter rewards.  With this new plan, I can bring players more of what they want sooner, and then re-work and finish the Official Tracks as the game gets closer to completion.  [b]New Official Tracks, plus the Halls of Glory, will get their “big reveal” during the Full Release of the game.[/b]


[i]This first Community Vote is an experiment.  If lots of people participate, then I’ll continue with the process.  Otherwise, I’ll revert to the traditional development system for the remainder of the project and update the Early Access description page accordingly.[/i]

Each Achievement is linked to an in-game Reward (Hats), so you can show-off your accomplishments with some sweet new headgear, such as these fine examples....

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/6a9ef94be21fecb1b3d6fa8eddea3c6bf0130050.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/15e170f981e1f93660e8aef8e99f4d35095cc673.png[/img]

[h1]LARRY'S HARDCORE ROCKET CHAIR CHALLENGES[/h1]

Larry is ready to compete at last.  Prepare yourself for some hardcore rocket-powered challenges!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/fcdbfbb23a411fc0aae6def671bbb329274e28e9.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Added 7 Official Tracks
[*]Built in a brand new map: Lucid City
[/list]

Larry and his rocket lawn chair are finally out of the prototype stage, but it's still unruly vehicle (it is just 4 rockets strapped to a chair, after all).  It will definitely take some practice and skill to master this unique character and his deadly courses.  If you have any troubles don't fret, more Class F characters will be added later, with easier controls and handling.

[b]SUPER IMPORTANT TIP:  use the "Roll" buttons to turn Larry in the air![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/799dc73a03ff63f0e69c620aa5ace44bf3144ea9.png[/img]

[u]Larry Improvements:[/u]
[list]
[*]Improved automatic camera rotation issues when vehicle is at extreme angles; general camera and control improvements
[*]Increased rocket power, for more responsive control
[*]Increased character's strength; can survive impacts and landings more easily
[*]New voice audio; Larry finally has a real voice!
[*]Removed "prototype" status
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/d5282280df5b87f325e6b075deeb5a8e1b8207b5.png[/img]

[h1]MOAR GIBS PLZ. OKAY![/h1]

Blood and gore FX for major body parts has been improved even more.  Added dynamic blood spray when major parts are dismembered, as well as little meat chunks and bone fragments for even more satisfying and bloody damage.

Too much?  No worries... a setting will be added later for adjusting blood amounts.

[h1]NEW HAZARDS[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/d32ab460e704f47ccf7146a9b768c9e19f914969.png[/img]

[b]Death Lasers[/b]

You requested lasers, you got lasers!  These deadly red beams will instantly heat any flesh they touch to an exploding point!

These don't target the player directly, but instead point in a fixed direction or rotate in a predictible manner.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/ee32c3b4c4488e835ab065d9e6890405b7c1e295.jpg[/img]

[b]Reflector Rays[/b]

These experimental death beams were originally invented by Larry himself, but when he went off the deep end, his brother and arch-nemsis, Harry, stole the credit and the glory.  Now Larry's own invention is being used against him!

Watch out when you see one of these.  They can be reflected up to 100 times off of specific surfaces and shoot 3 times farther than red beams.
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/3095a6ab8d89d2278f8e16f5c9d4814f79f37a1b.jpg[/img]

[b]Smart Bombs[/b]

Another product of Larry's genius, these rocket-powered explosives will seek out their target and then lock-on when within range, exploding after a designated time.  When you start to see them flash red you better get out the way!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/56bbd7432bf80f23172c204b86d01110846542fb.jpg[/img]

[h1]GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS / BUG FIXES[/h1]

Lots of bug fixes and other improvements, major and minor.

Improved Control Mapping system:
- Control elements can now be assigned to multiple inputs (click "Add" instead of "Replace" when re-assigned inputs)
- UI navigation elements can now be re-assigned as well.

Community Track Menu Improvements:
- Community Tracks Menu now pops up immediately in-game; removes unnecessary load time.
- Fixed bug that caused Community Tracks filter to stop working after using "Change Track" or return arrow buttons from Pause Menu in Community Tracks.
- Improved controller/keyboard navigation for the new Community Tracks menu (still needs more work)

Other Bug Fixes / Improvements:
- Fixed language settings menu bugs
- Fixed bug that caused music to restart during respawn, instead of playing continuously.
- Removed "Main Menu" button from Pause Menu during Level Editor "Quick Play" mode.
- Fixed Chapel Hill terrain bug that caused blood splatter to not show and crashes/missing terrain on some machines.
- Replaced custom road shaders with more performant standard shaders.
- Minor improvements to "smart cam" predictive movements for all vehicle classes
- Added 30+ Hats, which will be linked to new Achievemnts over time.

Localization:
- Finished adding remaining Level Editor Objects to localization system (ATTN TRANSLATORS: only terms ending in "_ObjectMap" are important; others are optional, since they also have image icons).
- Assorted language edits

NOTE: Localization updates will be minimal during Early Access, since everything continually changes.  Localization will be given a final, major review and update when the game nears completion.

notes.title: Workshop Menu 2.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27374378/36e5e15c4e1b9928f437647e3b11936d9f7187ad.png[/img]

[h1]The Community Tracks menu just got a major overhaul![/h1]

Now you can do all of the following with Steam Workshop levels, [i]directly in-game.[/i]

[list]
[*]Sort Levels by: votes, trending, subscriptions, newest, installed, and your own creations
[*]Search by Text
[*]Vote levels up or down
[*]Add to your Favorites list
[*]One-click Subscribe/Un-subscribe
[*]See Stats for each level (votes, subs, favorites)
[/list]

Personal Best Times are still shown for each track (so you can easily see what you have played already and to compete with friends), but the Vehicle Class icons have been removed due to lack of space.  Level Descriptions have been increased to 256 characters.  Longer descriptions are still shown in full on the Steam Workshop website though.

Overall, this should make finding, sharing and playing new Workshop levels super fast and easy, and keep new stuff from being buried. ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Localization Update[/h1]

Chinese and French translations have been reviewed and improved.  Spanish and Turkish human translation improvements will be added soon as too.  I'm sorting through some other submissions as well, so please be patient if you do not see your submissions shown in the game right away.

[b]All Localization updates sync to the Google server once per week.[/b]

[h1]Translators[/h1]

I began adding the Level Editor Categories and Objects to the Localization Document.  It's a fairly long list, so it's only about 70% done right now.  I marked new text added to the Localization Document in yellow, under the "Key" column.  (Items with "_ObjectMap" at the end are the most important.  Others have image icons.)

[h1]Bug Fixes and Minor Stuff[/h1]


- Fixed bug that sometimes caused music to stop when returning from Community Tracks.
- Fixed some static text that was not getting localized.
- Made blood splatter "flat" due to poor gloss reflection issues and artifacts on some graphics cards.
- And probably some other little things I didn't write down ːsteammockingː

[h1]Guts and Glory is now available in other languages![/h1]
Spread the word!

[u]It now has human translations for:[/u]

- Chinese (Simplified)
- Chinese (Traditional)
- Spanish
- French
- German

[u]And Google Translations for:[/u]

- Japanese
- Korean
- Russian
- Italian
- Turkish (some human edits)
- Arabic
- Estonian
- Portuguese (Brazil)

Please visit [url=http://www.hakjak.com/blog/2017/3/27/wanted-localization-volunteers]this post[/url], if you want to help revise the Google Translations so they make more sense, or if you want to add NEW languages to the game!

[h1]Live Translations[/h1]

EDIT:  Live translations have been disabled due to errors from Google for too many requests.  I will work on another way.

In addition to static translations, I also added live Google Translations for Community Tracks, so players around the world can share their creations with minimal barriers (requires internet connection, of course).

The game should automatically adjust to your computer's system language, but if it does not, just visit the Settings Menu and you can select a language there.

*** Please restart the game if you change the language manually. ***

As new human translations / revisions become available, they will automatically sync to the game once per week, as long as you have an internet connection.

notes.title: v0.4.1: Control Customization and New Settings
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/lEURqx8.png[/img]

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Settings Menu
[*]Controller Mapping and Sensitivity Settings
[*]Improved car handling
[*]Minor optimizations & bug fixes
[/list]

IMPORTANT NOTE:  You will need to adjust your Settings next time you enter the game.  Defaults are low quality.

[h1]Control Customization[/h1]

Control customization, expanded controller support, and improved handling seemed to be top priorities, so that’s what this update is all about!

[b]You will find that your settings have reset next time you launch the game.[/b]  This is because the temporary Settings Menu has been completely replaced.  This new system is more professional and allows for a lot of room to expand the options as things grow.  It should also be more reliable than the old settings and work better on different aspect rations and resolutions.  It’s all brand new though, so if you run into any issues please let me know.

[b]Control Menu[/b]
There is now a full control mapping and customization system!
I completely un-installed and re-setup all of the controller support plug-ins and mappings.  I discovered a few issues with how it was setup initially, so this should be a nice, clean install of all controller support features.
You can finally map your own keyboard and controller buttons!  There are also sensitivity settings, so you can adjust how smoothly steering works, etc.
 
Mouse control support has been requested several times, so I added options for mapping that as well.  However, it is very experimental right now and may not work for everyone; [i]more work to be done on this feature, but just wanted to get some feedback on it so far.[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/yuYxUJ8.png[/img]

[h1]Vehicle Handling[/h1]
I spent several hours tweaking the car handling controls.  I softened up the steering, reduced the assists, increased standard braking slightly, and adjusted wheel frictions and physics settings.  This fixed the problems with turning the vehicle at mid-high speeds without drift, and made handling feel more natural overall.  It’s still a drift-focused vehicle though!

I also spent a little bit of time tweaking Earl’s ATV handling.  [b]He still has “drunken controls”,[/b] but I did soften things up a bit to make it a little easier to handle.  Maybe more work to be done on this later, but let me know what you guys think. 

Bike handling is the same.  I’ve found that on some controllers it handles very differently than others though, so you may want to tweak the steer sensitivity settings accordingly.

[h1]Spikes[/h1]
I noticed a lot of people have been making the spikes very large.  This broke how the spike mechanics worked, so I did a quick fix on that.  Basically, the spikes have an invisible collider box around them.  Any characters that touch that box get stuck by the spikes.  I just increased the size of this collider to match the spikes.

I will create a new “High Quality Spike” object in the next update that will have individual colliders for each spike so they will behave more realistically if scaled large.  They will just have higher "complexity cost" to place.

[b]Other Stuff[/b]
I did some minor optimizations on the new Yang tracks to stabilize and improve FPS some.  In a future update I’ll be giving all levels a major optimization pass, but I just haven’t had time to do that yet.

The first Yang track has an experimental new road shader.  Still working through some issues with that not displaying properly on all graphics cards.

Fixed a handful of bugs, including one that kept all relevant vehicle options from being presented in the Official Tracks.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/a9nNy5W.png[/img]

[h1]Settings[/h1]
There is no automatic quality adjustments system setup yet, so the default settings are fairly low quality.  You’ll want to take a minute to adjust the settings when you first launch the game.  In particular, you’ll want to set Quality, Resolution, and Shadow Settings.

[u]Below is an explanation of some of the more obscure settings:[/u]
[list]
[*]Anisotropic Texturing: Makes textures look better at extreme angles.  No need to set to anything lower than “Force Enable” unless you are running that game at or below minimum requirements.
[*]Texture Quality: For low-end setups.  No need to lower this unless your graphics card has low memory or you’re running the game on a very low-end machine.
[*]V-Sync:  Turning v-sync on can tank your FPS!  Only use this if you experience “screen tearing”.  That’s when images look cut/staggered on the screen.
[*]Realtime Reflections: I have this highly optimized, so you shouldn’t need to turn it off unless running on low-end machine.
[*]Shadow Projection: only need to adjust this if shadows seem to be rendering strangely for you.
[*]Shadow Quality: I will add another option to this later for even higher quality.  Generally two cascades will give you good results.  You can turn this off if you have FPS issues though.
[*]Shadow Distance: This can have a significant performance on FPS stability.  Reduce this distance if you have FPS issues.
[*]LOD Bias:  This determines how detailed models appear based on how far away they are.  I don’t recommend going below 0.5 on this or some objects may not appear at all (I need to put a limit on this next update).  1-2 will give you really good results.
[/list]

I'm planning out future updates and timelines and will let y'all know when I have a rough plan in place to show.

I spent several hours tweaking the car handling controls.  I softened up the steering, reduced the assists, increased standard braking slightly, and adjusted wheel frictions and physics settings.  This fixed the problems with turning the vehicle at mid-high speeds without drift, and made handling feel more natural overall.  It’s still a drift-focused vehicle though!

I also spent a little bit of time tweaking Earl’s ATV handling.  [b]He still has “drunken controls”,[/b] but I did soften things up a bit to make it a little easier to handle.  Maybe more work to be done on this later, but let me know what you guys think. 

Bike handling is the same.  I’ve found that on some controllers it handles very differently than others though, so you may want to tweak the steer sensitivity settings accordingly.

[h1]Spikes[/h1]
I noticed a lot of people have been making the spikes very large.  This broke how the spike mechanics worked, so I did a quick fix on that.  Basically, the spikes have an invisible collider box around them.  Any characters that touch that box get stuck by the spikes.  I just increased the size of this collider to match the spikes.

I will create a new “High Quality Spike” object in the next update that will have individual colliders for each spike so they will behave more realistically if scaled large.  They will just have higher "complexity cost" to place.

[b]Other Stuff[/b]
I did some minor optimizations on the new Yang tracks to stabilize and improve FPS some.  In a future update I’ll be giving all levels a major optimization pass, but I just haven’t had time to do that yet.

The first Yang track has an experimental new road shader.  Still working through some issues with that not displaying properly on all graphics cards.

Fixed a handful of bugs, including one that kept all relevant vehicle options from being presented in the Official Tracks.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/a9nNy5W.png[/img]

[h1]Settings[/h1]
There is no automatic quality adjustments system setup yet, so the default settings are fairly low quality.  You’ll want to take a minute to adjust the settings when you first launch the game.  In particular, you’ll want to set Quality, Resolution, and Shadow Settings.

[u]Below is an explanation of some of the more obscure settings:[/u]
[list]
[*]Anisotropic Texturing: Makes textures look better at extreme angles.  No need to set to anything lower than “Force Enable” unless you are running that game at or below minimum requirements.
[*]Texture Quality: For low-end setups.  No need to lower this unless your graphics card has low memory or you’re running the game on a very low-end machine.
[*]V-Sync:  Turning v-sync on can tank your FPS!  Only use this if you experience “screen tearing”.  That’s when images look cut/staggered on the screen.
[*]Realtime Reflections: I have this highly optimized, so you shouldn’t need to turn it off unless running on low-end machine.
[*]Shadow Projection: only need to adjust this if shadows seem to be rendering strangely for you.
[*]Shadow Quality: I will add another option to this later for even higher quality.  Generally two cascades will give you good results.  You can turn this off if you have FPS issues though.
[*]Shadow Distance: This can have a significant performance on FPS stability.  Reduce this distance if you have FPS issues.
[*]LOD Bias:  This determines how detailed models appear based on how far away they are.  I don’t recommend going below 0.5 on this or some objects may not appear at all (I need to put a limit on this next update).  1-2 will give you really good results.
[/list]

I'm planning out future updates and timelines and will let y'all know when I have a rough plan in place to show.

notes.content:
Just uploaded a small patch that fixes a handful of issues reported by you guys so far, including:

[list]
[*]Expanded controller support.  Hopefully fixes Xbox 360 controller issues.  Also adds generic steering wheel support (experimental).
[*]Improved Community Tracks screen and Workshop links
[*]Changes to the [i]temporary[/i] Settings Menu to work with more aspect ratios/resolutions
[*]Simple, fast anti-aliasing for smoother edges.
[*]Increased ATV strength so wheels don't break off [i]quite[/i] as easily.
[*]A handful of minor bug fixes
[/list]

[b]Xbox 360 Controllers[/b]
I own a few different types of controllers, but strangely enough no 360 controllers, so I could not test this myself.  I updated all the controller plug-ins and expanded the default mappings.  Also built a special default mapping for 360 controllers in hopes of providing a fix.  Please let me know if the forums if issues persist with 360 controllers.

I had a couple requests for steering wheel inputs, so I setup a generic map for that.  Not tested.

[b]Community Tracks Menu[/b]
I simplified the Community Tracks menu to try and make everything easier to understand for newcomers.  Also centers everything to work better on more types of screens.  Steam Overlay feature should work more reliably now as well, but still trying to narrow down why it sometimes does not pop up.

Let me know if you guys think it needs tweaked further.
